codex_consult.feedback_summary: Codex confirmed zero Standards 1-11 violations. Two findings raised: (1) a wording improvement to Standard 6 rationale expanding the scope statement to include hooks and .py/.sh scripts (still not applicable to .tpl); (2) an observation about candidateCardStyle() usage in the working tree vs HEAD, which is outside the inspector's scope (HEAD commit was inspected).

findings.rationale: This observation conflates the working tree with the HEAD commit.
